title: Bitewe n'ikosa ry'imiterere
description: Iki kiganiro kiragera kuri AI ntarengwa yo kwibuka, nkibibaho byuzura. Turashobora kwagura idirishya rya memoire (bita ingano yimiterere) kugirango yibuke byinshi, ariko irashobora gukoresha byinshi mububiko bwa mudasobwa yawe. Turashobora kandi kugabanya ibyinjijwe, bivuze ko bizibagirwa amwe mumateka yo kuganira kugirango tubone umwanya wubutumwa bushya.
contextOverflowDetail: Iki cyifuzo cyari gikeneye ibimenyetso {{request}}, ariko idirishya ryerekana imiterere rifite {{context}} gusa.
emptyReply: Icyitegererezo cyarangiye adasubije igisubizo. Gerageza kuvugurura, cyangwa kugenzura igenamiterere ryabatanga.

engine.MODEL_ARCH_NOT_SUPPORTED: Iyi moderi yububiko ntabwo ishyigikiwe na moteri iriho. Kuvugurura moteri kuva Igenamiterere birashobora kongera inkunga.
engine.MODEL_LOAD_TIMED_OUT: Icyitegererezo cyatwaye igihe kinini kugirango kiremere kirahagarikwa. Icyitegererezo gito cyangwa ingano ntoya isanzwe ifasha.
engine.MISSING_SHARED_LIBRARY: Isomero moteri ikeneye irabura, ntishobora rero gutangira.
engine.GPU_DRIVER_TOO_OLD: Umushoferi wawe GPU arashaje cyane kuri moteri. Kuvugurura umushoferi, cyangwa guhindura moteri ya CPU muri Igenamiterere, bizakemura ibi.
engine.OUT_OF_MEMORY: Nta bubiko buhagije bwo gukoresha iyi moderi. Icyitegererezo gito cyangwa ingano ntoya isanzwe ifasha.
engine.IO_ERROR: Idosiye ntishobora gusomwa cyangwa kwandikwa mugihe utangiye icyitegererezo.
engine.INTERNAL_ERROR: Ikintu kitagenze neza muri Novera mugihe utangiye icyitegererezo.
engine.ENGINE_UNREACHABLE: Moteri ya llama.cpp irakora, ariko Novera ntishobora kuyihuza niyi mudasobwa (127.0.0.1). VPN, porogaramu cyangwa umutekano birashobora guhagarika imiyoboro yaho.
engine.ENGINE_STOPPED: Moteri ya llama.cpp yahagaze mu buryo butunguranye. Kohereza ubutumwa byongeye biratangira; niba ikomeje guhagarara, software yumutekano cyangwa GPU umushoferi birashobora kuba impamvu.
engine.UNSUPPORTED_CPU: Moderi zaho ntizishyigikirwa kuri mudasobwa ya mudasobwa. Moteri ya Novera yubatswe kuri Mac Silicon Macs (M1 cyangwa nshya), ntishobora rero gutangirira kuri Intel Mac. Igicu nabatanga ibicuruzwa baracyakora.
